# Results walkthrough: index and provenance

*Generated by `eval/figs_results_walkthrough.py` at commit `441e97c`. COMPOSITION ONLY: existing, cross-checked images are placed on pages; nothing is re-plotted, recomputed or re-run. All provenance is here; the pages carry none.*

**Checks:** 64/64 reused lines equal their source string exactly; 6 lines MODIFIED (each listed with its original); 41 NEW lines (number guard: every number in a NEW or MODIFIED line occurs in the figure's own index entry or in that page's summary strings: PASS); world check 11/11 page groups match the trials' recorded worlds. Failures: none.

**Text source.** Reused lines come from `docs/thesis/summary/index_summary.md`, which `eval/figs_thesis_summary.py` writes from the same strings it draws on the summary pages. Before building, that script was re-run on a scratch copy at HEAD `441e97c` with only its output folder redirected: the regenerated `index_summary.md` was identical apart from its commit line, and all 13 summary PNGs were byte-identical to the committed ones; the footer-rule rows used to crop the summary charts (`top` + 0.012 = 0.2945 / 0.266 / 0.323 / 0.2945 / 0.323 for summary pages 02 / 03 / 10 / 11 / 12) come from that run and are asserted on the committed PNGs at build time. The five closed-loop check phrases inserted into page 08's pass rule are asserted to occur in `eval/figs_thesis_summary.py`.

**Layout.** A4 landscape; PNGs at 200 dpi; images embedded unresampled (`interpolation='none'`). Text ≥ 11 pt (Metric, Pass rule, Result, About, world captions: 11 pt; What this tests: 12.5 pt; titles 16.5 pt). 'scale' below = displayed width ÷ the image's width at 200 dpi (the summary charts are 150 dpi images and are never enlarged beyond their own size).

**PDF:** `results_walkthrough.pdf` = contents (`walkthrough/wt_00a_contents.png`), 'How to read these pages' (the summary's `summary_00_how_to_read.png`, sha256 `6a3bd6d2e50d98eb3d357b0c2969414043f628b82f2d2160e89b1a62b21ddadf`, placed full page unchanged), then pages 01–14 below.

**Contents-page note (NEW):** Each page shows one experiment: what it tests, the simulated world it was flown in (screenshots, top right), the original detailed plot, and under it what the plot shows, the metric, the pass rule and the result. In the corridor plots, dashed lines mean without the camera heading and solid lines with it. Where an experiment has no detailed plot, its summary chart is shown instead.

## Not included, and why

- **Figure 3.1 (system architecture):** method, not a result.
- **Tables A.1–A.3 and the other thesis tables:** tables, not time-series or path plots; their pass/fail content is in the summary lines already shown.
- **Experiments with no detailed time-series or path plot** use their summary chart (cropped to the chart): the blank floor (page 04), the 1B heading check (05), Experiment 5 hold (12) and tag loss (13), and 5S (14).
- **No onboard frame of the half-and-half floor with plain walls** exists (`world_images/index.md` §4); page 05 notes that the half-and-half floor is not pictured.
